name: mostafa-al-ashrafy-pms
description: Cloud hotel property-management system for Red Sea, Sinai and Saudi independents. Built from the Kwentra competitive research report (Sept 2026).

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push -w apps/api && npm run db:seed -w apps/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
